Maria / Procurement / Devin — attaching a redline (MSA_redline_kiyer_08132026.docx) and summarizing the key legal positions below so it's easy to track in procurement.

1) Audit rights (proposed language):
- Customer is entitled to inspect (i) SOC 2 Type II reports and associated management responses, (ii) control artifacts (policy excerpts, configuration snapshots), and (iii) network-level test results for the customer's tenant.
- Inspection does NOT include source code, internal development pipelines, or unrestricted console access. Any additional access requests will be evaluated under a separate NDA and scoped SOW.

2) Penetration testing (proposed language):
- Redwood will cooperate with third-party assessors approved in writing (e.g., Redlock). Tests will be performed against vendor-provided ephemeral staging that mirrors production traffic; Redwood will provide access windows not to exceed 48 continuous hours per test and up to 3 scheduled tests per calendar year. Redwood will require 10 business days' notice and will coordinate test start/stop and impact mitigation.

3) Evidence cadence & delivery (proposed):
- Quarterly: SOC control snapshot (summary sheet + key logs) via secure Drive link.
- Annual: Full SOC evidence bundle (PDFs, configurations, sanitized logs) delivered to a secure SFTP.
- For live incident requests or special audits, Redwood will produce a scoped evidence package within 5 business days subject to legal review and redaction for other customers' data.

4) Data handling & sampling:
- PII exports for evidence will be sampled and redacted by Redwood. If Aurelia requires tenant-specific full exports, that will be scheduled as a scoped activity with explicit consent and either a Data Processing Addendum or Escrow arrangement.

Operational notes for Devin (Redlock): please confirm your minimum scoping needs for the pen test (external vs internal, authenticated tests, social engineering excluded) and whether you need packet captures — we can provide logs but packet captures will require tighter redaction controls.

If this aligns with Aurelia's expectations, we can finalize the redline and track in procurement. If you want any of the language softened/expanded, call out exact sentence-level edits and we'll respond.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal, Contracts
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: MSA_redline_kiyer_08132026.docx (DOCX, 28KB)
